description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5310145299111 NUT,SELF-LOCKING,EX: Line 0001 Qty 9085 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0096 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
